title: Separation regime requested by the problem is not proved (only a summary bullet)

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
The problem statement explicitly asks to characterize the regime of 'separation between components'. The solution addresses this only in a Summary bullet, asserting 'with strong separation the assignment becomes unambiguous and the problem is tractable', with NO theorem, algorithm, or quantitative separation condition and no proof.

To complete the characterization, add a proposition with a precise separation condition (e.g. pairwise center separation $\Delta$ vs within-cluster radius $\rho$, or $\Delta\gtrsim\sigma\sqrt{\log n}$) under which the optimal $k$-means Voronoi partition is unique and recoverable in $\mathrm{poly}(n,d)$ (e.g. by thresholding / single-linkage / a Lloyd step from good seeds). Then by the sandwich (lem:sandwich) $L^\ast$ is pinned to within additive $n\log k$ efficiently. Cite a precise separation model (Dasgupta 1999; Kumar-Kannan; Awasthi-Sheffet; Vempala-Wang) and prove the uniqueness/recoverability claim.
